name: Konno Yuusuke
source:
Konno Yuusuke is Makoto's classmate in the Magic Department. He is reticent, curt, and doesn't seem to care about anything (or anyone) besides himself. Because of this, he often falls into many misunderstandings, though he possesses a gentle side. He tends to turn brusque when he gets embarrassed.

Konno often looks bored with being there, especially when he seems to ace his magic classwork without even trying, and looks to be just going through the motions of attending. But he's careful to not let anyone into his personal bubble, choosing to keep everyone at arms-length, and seems to be just riding out his life at school, limiting his interactions with people.

Special Skill: Magic as a whole / Mixing cocktails
Type Preference: Someone who isn't fussy
Personality: Unfriendly, but gentle at heart, and likes small animals.

"I just did as I liked. It was nothing to warrant being thanked for."

[From English patch notes]
